item.title: Optimizing care and quality indicators in the management of patients with acute ischaemic heart disease and atherothrombotic stroke: measuring to improve - Drugs in Context
item.description: The aim of this article is to develop an integrated organizational model for the care of acute ischaemic heart disease and atherothrombotic stroke, incorporating validated and measurable quality indicators to improve patient outcomes and care coordination.

item.title: The convergent pathway of obstructive lung disease: the disease-modifying potential of dipeptidyl peptidase 1 inhibition in COPD, asthma and bronchiectasis overlap - Drugs in Context
item.description: This review synthesizes the pathophysiology and key aspects of bronchiectasis–COPD overlap syndrome and analyses the clinical evidence for brensocatib as the first potential disease-modifying therapy for this neutrophilic endotype designed to break the cycle.

item.title: Ustekinumab-associated morphoea: systematic review of the literature and a real-world case - Drugs in Context
item.description: The authors describe a new case of morphoea developing during ustekinumab therapy for Behçet disease and review all published reports, integrating clinical, histopathological and therapeutic findings to explore potential immunopathogenic mechanisms underlying this paradoxical fibrotic reaction.

item.title: Emerging concepts in HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis: focus on twice-yearly lenacapavir - Drugs in Context
item.description: Lenacapavir (LEN), a first in-class capsid inhibitor, is approved as a twice-yearly subcutaneous injection for HIV prevention and represents a major advance beyond daily oral and bi-monthly injectable long-acting pre-exposure prophylaxis regimens.

item.title: Corrigendum: Primary hyperhidrosis: an updated review - Drugs in Context
item.description: The authors wish to make the following corrections to their article: Maazi M, Leung AKC, Lam JM. Primary hyperhidrosis: an updated review. Drugs Context. 2025;14:2025-3-2. https://doi.org/10.7573/dic.2025-3-2

item.title: Real-world effectiveness of a phlebotonic formulation combining diosmin, Ruscus, Melilotus and Vitis vinifera on symptoms and quality of life in patients with chronic venous and lymphatic disease: results from the VIVEMA Stasis observational study - Drugs in Context
item.description: The VIVEMA Stasis observational study was designed to evaluate the symptom burden, oedema reduction and quality of life in patients with chronic venous disease, lymphoedema and/or phlebolymphatic oedema treated with a phlebotonic formulation containing diosmin, Ruscus aculeatus, Melilotus officinalis and Vitis vinifera, combined with functional bandaging and elastic compression therapy.

item.title: Antibiotic treatment for neonatal sepsis: changing trends and future directions - Drugs in Context
item.description: This article provides an updated review on the aetiology and diagnosis of neonatal sepsis, antibiotic management and antibiotic stewardship.

item.title: Corrigendum: Role of a topical hydrogel (Dermatix® wound care gel) in acute and chronic wound management: a case series of real-world experiences and expert opinion from Asia - Drugs in Context
item.description: The post Corrigendum: Role of a topical hydrogel (Dermatix® wound care gel) in acute and chronic wound management: a case series of real-world experiences and expert opinion from Asia appeared first on Drugs in Context.

item.title: Biologics-induced cutaneous pseudolymphomas: a narrative review with an illustrative case of brodalumab-induced pseudolymphoma - Drugs in Context
item.description: The authors provide a concise narrative review of biologic-induced cutaneous pseudolymphomas and illustrate the topic with the first reported case of brodalumab-induced pseudolymphoma in a patient with psoriasis.

item.title: Evaluating oritavancin for Gram-positive infections: a systematic review of on-label and off-label use - Drugs in Context
item.description: This systematic review evaluates the efficacy, safety and clinical use of oritavancin across on-label and off-label indications.
